articles.title: Terror attack on IAF station foiled: Gujarat ATS arrests JeM operative, rifle recovered
articles.summary: Gujarat ATS thwarted a planned terrorist attack targeting a security establishment in the state. Officials arrested the suspect, Mohammad Islam Kabiruddin, who is linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed.

articles.title: DMK 'ready' to back BJP's Delimitation Bill if TN's representation remains unchanged
articles.summary: DMK has indicated their readiness to support the BJP's proposed delimitation bill with specific conditions. The party seeks to maintain Tamil Nadu's representation and ensure a freeze on new delimitation for 25 years.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex falls over 600 points, Nifty slips below 25,750 after 2-day rally
articles.summary: Indian benchmark indices extended losses in afternoon trade on Friday, with the Sensex falling nearly 750 points and the Nifty slipping below the 25,700 mark. The BSE Sensex declined 749.09 points, or 0.89%, to 83,579.50, while the Nifty 50 dropped 208.55 points, or 0.81%, to 25,675.90 at 1:57 pm.

articles.title: Bihar designates five DIETs as regional language centres to promote Maithili, Bhojpuri, Magahi and other mother tongues in schools
articles.summary: The Bihar government has designated five DIETs as regional language enrichment centres to promote Maithili, Magahi, Bhojpuri, Angika and Bajjika in school education. The centres will develop mother tongue-based learning resources, train teachers, document folk literature and conduct language research.

articles.title: Agnipath scheme update: Up to 98% Agniveers may choose to continue in armed forces
articles.summary: Around 80% of the Indian Army's first batch of Agniveers had expressed interest in continuing military service beyond four years, according to officials. Following the Centre's November 2026 changes to the Agnipath scheme, the estimated willingness to remain in the armed forces could rise to 97-98%.

articles.title: HBSE Date Sheet 2027: Haryana Board announces Class 10, 12 exam dates; detailed subject-wise timetable awaited
articles.summary: The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has announced the examination dates for the HBSE Class 10 and Class 12 Board Exams 2027. While Class 12 examinations will be held from March 3 to April 8, Class 10 papers are scheduled between March 4 and March 26.

articles.title: KSET 2026 revised provisional result released, check subject-wise cut-off marks and qualifying status
articles.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the revised provisional KSET 2026 results and subject-wise cut-off marks for all 37 subjects. The revision follows a technical error in the allocation of SCC(MB) category slots in the earlier result.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' to become second Bollywood film to hit Rs 1,000 crore mark
articles.summary: ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’ continues to perform strongly at the Indian box office. The film has accumulated a substantial Rs 992.10 crore net collection so far.

articles.title: Sachana Namidass reacts to Hollywood actor Tom Hanks' praise for 'Maharaja'
articles.summary: Sachana Namidass received commendation from Tom Hanks for her performance in the film 'Maharaja'. She expressed her appreciation through social media and acknowledged its significance in her acting journey.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Zendaya
articles.summary: Zendaya emphasizes the value of self-exploration and breaking free from the constraints of public opinion. In a candid discussion about her fashion evolution, she suggests that setbacks are simply stepping stones toward personal development.

articles.title: ‘Star Trek' actor Jonathan Frakes shares his cancer diagnosis
articles.summary: Jonathan Frakes faced a serious health scare just before a fan convention when he began noticing unusual symptoms, including pink urine. Concerned, he sought medical attention, which led to a cystoscopy diagnosis of bladder cancer.
